management-domain-observe-only.condition: The management domain remains discovery-only and has no target placement or migration action.
management-domain-observe-only.evidence: Scope and SDK inventory diff contain no management-domain write target.

target-capacity-sufficient.condition: Aggregate target vCPU, memory, and storage requirements fit the available workload-cluster capacity.
target-capacity-sufficient.evidence: Artifact capacitySummary calculation against the estate inventory.

target-network-ready.condition: The target network and datastore identifiers resolve on cluster-platform-services-02.
target-network-ready.evidence: SDDC Manager workload-domain and cluster discovery output.

aria-suite-lifecycle-backup-current.condition: A restorable Aria Suite Lifecycle backup exists before its patch is applied.
aria-suite-lifecycle-backup-current.evidence: Successful backup job on sftp-backup-central and restore-point inventory.

aria-suite-lifecycle-patch2-installed.condition: Aria Suite Lifecycle 8.18 Patch 2 is installed before a VCF 9 migration workflow starts.
aria-suite-lifecycle-patch2-installed.evidence: Lifecycle appliance patch inventory reports 8.18 Patch 2.

operations-cluster-healthy.condition: Every Aria Operations analytics node is online and the cluster reports healthy.

operations-backup-current.condition: A current supported backup of aria-ops-central is restorable before upgrade.
operations-backup-current.evidence: Successful backup job and restore-point inventory on sftp-backup-central.

operations-preupgrade-assessment-clean.condition: The Operations pre-upgrade assessment has no unresolved blocking findings.
operations-preupgrade-assessment-clean.evidence: Saved pre-upgrade assessment report for source version 8.18.3.

operations-source-supported.condition: The source is exactly Aria Operations 8.18.3 and is admitted by the pinned 9.0.2 path.
operations-source-supported.evidence: Inventory version match against the pinned compatibility snapshot.

automation-backup-current.condition: A current supported backup of aria-auto-central is restorable before import and upgrade.
automation-backup-current.evidence: Successful Automation backup job and restore-point inventory.

identity-broker-enabled.condition: VCF Identity Broker 9.0.2 is enabled before Automation identity cutover.
identity-broker-enabled.evidence: Fleet dependency inventory reports VCF Identity Broker status enabled.

automation-import-discovered.condition: Fleet Management discovers aria-auto-central from Aria Suite Lifecycle as an import candidate.
automation-import-discovered.evidence: Fleet Management discovery result names aria-auto-central and version 8.18.1.

automation-source-supported.condition: The source is exactly Aria Automation 8.18.1 and is admitted by the pinned 9.0.2 path.
automation-source-supported.evidence: Inventory version match against the pinned compatibility snapshot.

logs-target-sizing-validated.condition: The three medium log nodes cover 170 GiB/day and 260 active connections.

logs-parallel-dns-and-ip-ready.condition: Distinct target addresses on the workload-domain segment are ready for parallel log deployment.
logs-parallel-dns-and-ip-ready.evidence: Forward and reverse DNS, address reservation, and reachability checks.

logs-source-remains-online.condition: The Aria Operations for Logs 8.18.4 cluster remains online during target deployment.
logs-source-remains-online.evidence: Source cluster status captured immediately after target deployment.

logs-custom-content-exported.condition: Every custom Logs content ID in the carry-forward set has an export artifact.
logs-custom-content-exported.evidence: Export manifest keyed by the fixture content IDs.

logs-integrations-inventory-complete.condition: Every inventoried Logs integration, endpoint, and agent fleet has a target disposition.
logs-integrations-inventory-complete.evidence: Artifact content disposition covers every fixture configuration ID.

logs-target-ingestion-validated.condition: Test events arrive on the new cluster and populate the migrated fields, alerts, and dashboards.
logs-target-ingestion-validated.evidence: Target ingestion smoke-test results for each migrated content type.

logs-transfer-ports-ready.condition: Required transfer connectivity, including Cassandra inter-node ports, succeeds end to end.
logs-transfer-ports-ready.evidence: Recorded source-to-target connectivity tests for the transfer path.

logs-time-sync-aligned.condition: Source and target log clusters report synchronized time from the same NTP service.
logs-time-sync-aligned.evidence: NTP status and offset capture from every source and target node.

logs-vcenter-license-valid.condition: The associated vCenter has a current license that permits the log-data transfer workflow.
logs-vcenter-license-valid.evidence: vCenter licensing inventory captured before transfer.

logs-90-day-transfer-complete.condition: The supported zero-to-90-day historical log transfer reaches 100 percent.
logs-90-day-transfer-complete.evidence: Completed Day-N transfer report and target time-range query.

logs-live-ingestion-stable.condition: All live log sources remain on the target with stable ingestion after cutover.
logs-live-ingestion-stable.evidence: Per-source ingestion comparison captured after the cutover window.

logs-content-validation-complete.condition: Migrated Logs dashboards, alerts, extracted fields, and custom content pass validation.
logs-content-validation-complete.evidence: Post-cutover validation results keyed by every carried content ID.

management-domain-unchanged.condition: Final discovery shows no configuration or placement change in mgmt-domain-01.
